name: The Other Player
source: [spoiler]Another player playing Ar Nosurge, from Nero's home universe. They are cruel and want nothing more than to achieve "100% completion" by killing all the characters. They are controlling Prim's body and voice, and using her to attack and harm others.[/spoiler]
translation: [spoiler]Another player playing Ar Nosurge, from Nero's home universe. They are cruel and want nothing more than to achieve "100% completion" by killing all the characters. They are controlling Prim's body and voice, and using her to attack and harm others.[/spoiler]
